title: hermesVPS phase-070 finding record payload
description: Structured machine-readable output of phase 070 (reviewed-findings) for a single candidate. Used by generate-findings to build the consolidated findings export. Does not replace the canonical findings.schema.json used by the target repository's security/ store.

candidate_id.description: Stable candidate identifier from the phase-060 triage payload

source_commit.description: Full 40-char lowercase hex SHA of the inspected source commit; must equal run.json source.commit

prerequisite_artifact_id.description: ID of the phase-060 artifact this assessment is based on

assessment_disposition.description: Reviewer's determination about this candidate. Distinct from the canonical status field.

assessment_rationale.description: Explanation of the assessment_disposition. Must not be null for confirmed or dismissed.

affected_components.description: Affected code components, services, or subsystems (more specific than files[])

evidence.description: Concrete evidence entries supporting the assessment

unknowns.description: Unresolved uncertainties preserved from the assessment

blockers.description: Blockers that prevent a definitive assessment

proposed_finding.description: Proposed finding record. Fields match the canonical findings.schema.json where present. assessment_disposition is separate from canonical status.

id.description: Stable SG-NNN ID if already assigned; null for new findings pending ID assignment

status.description: Canonical status for the target repository findings store. 'open' for new findings; do not use 'fixed' merely because a remediation plan exists.
